How to fall asleep fast when your mind doesn’t want you to. Yang Mun.

#sleep #usahealth #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #newyork
transcript: How do you fall asleep fast when your mind refuses to slow down? Let me teach you a method that works like a light switch once you learn it. And no, it doesn't involve melatonin, supplements, hot showers, or reading before bed. Most people try to force the body to sleep while the mind is still awake. That's why you lie there overthinking. Your chest feels uneasy and your brain won't shut off. Here's the truth. Your body doesn't decide when you sleep. Your nervous system does. If it's activated, sleep is impossible. So instead of pushing your body, you need to signal your mind to let go. Step one, make your exhale longer than your inhale. Inhale for four, exhale for eight. This tells the heart you're safe. Step two, relax your tongue. When the tongue is tense, the brain stays alert. Softening it quiets your thoughts. Step three, bring all your attention to your feet. Feel their weight. When awareness moves downward, the thinking mind finally shuts off. This is just one method I teach. Because sleep problems aren't only about sleep, they come from emotional stress and imbalance in the mind and body. If you want deep asleep and real inner calm, the link in my bio will guide you to begin your 30-day healing journey.
